messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Reported spironolactone side effects:
Reported spironolactone side effects include breast and nipple pain in both men and women, a lower sex drive, trouble getting or keeping an erection, irregular or missed periods, bleeding after menopause, dizziness, headache, drowsiness, feeling sluggish, leg cramps, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach cramps, indigestion, hair thinning, and itching.
The most common side effect of spironolactone is breast growth in men, known as gynecomastia. In the main heart failure study, about 9 in 100 men taking an average of 26 mg a day developed it. The chance goes up on higher doses. It can start anywhere from one or two months into treatment to more than a year later, and it usually goes away after the medicine is stopped.
Several of these effects are dose-related, so they are more likely on higher doses, and many settle after the dose is lowered or the medicine is stopped. How often most of them happen is not known, because they come from reports gathered after the medicine was approved rather than from counted numbers in trials.
Triplet: ["spironolactone", "has side effect resolution after", "stopping the medicine"]

The relation 'has side effect resolution after' in the triplet is defined as 'The adverse effect specified by the object entity typically resolves after the subject drug is stopped or the dose is lowered.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires gradual dose reduction': The subject drug must be reduced in dose slowly over the time period specified by the object entity to avoid adverse effects.
B. 'has withdrawal symptom': When the subject drug is stopped abruptly, the patient may experience the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
